Title: Protect data in use with Azure Confidential Computing

Body.Content:
Azure Confidential Computing helps to secure your data while it’s in use. Azure is the first cloud platform to protect the confidentiality and integrity of data while in use—adding to the protections already in place to encrypt data in transit and at rest.

Azure Confidential Computing benefits are now available on a new DC-series of virtual machines in Azure for preview using Intel SGX chipsets. In addition, Azure is also offering an open source SDK to provide a consistent enclave abstraction experience to build your SGX-based applications.

For more information on the DC-series of virtual machines and their capabilities, visit our webpage.
